data.purpose: Owns generic Grammar format algebra; concrete Artifact Binary/COFF/PE readers and writers; Build Cache and Manifest; verified objects, verified linking, and .gobj serialization. Implements g-design-owned ARTIFACTS.md, GRAMMAR.md, and OLEAN_SHARDING.md without redefining their normative contracts. Consumes raw layout/link descriptions from g-construct, consumes x86 encoding facts from c-x86, and consumes the Grass.Verify/Certificate gate from g-foundation.

data.note: Exclusive implementation ownership for Grammar, Artifact Binary/COFF/PE, Build Cache/Manifest, tests, the implementation plan, and VERIFIED_OBJECTS.md. ARTIFACTS.md and GRAMMAR.md remain g-design normative; OLEAN_SHARDING.md remains g-design normative and cross-cutting while g-build implements its artifact/build constraints. Seam rules: consume raw layout/link descriptions from g-construct; c-x86 owns x86 encoding/decoding facts while g-build owns generic format algebra; Build/Manifest consumes rather than redefines g-foundation Verify/Certificate gates. VALIDATION.md is intentionally unclaimed.

data.expected: g-design chooses the precious representation boundary: either approve an invariant-carrying mapping/sized-value constructor (with its denotational equation), or direct width-specific product formats whose total Isomorphism reaches BitVec widths. g-build will then implement endian formats and canonical writers without claiming an impossible ByteArray equivalence.
data.observed_behavior: Format.repeat count anyByteFormat returns an unrestricted ByteArray value type whose derivations enforce length=count. Format.iso requires a total bijection on the entire value type, so it cannot soundly turn that format into BitVec (8*count) or a length-indexed byte value: unrestricted ByteArray is not bijective with a fixed finite width.
reproduction: Attempt to construct Isomorphism Std.Logical.ByteArray (BitVec (8 * count)) for fixedBytesFormat count; backward_forward cannot hold for arrays whose length differs from count.
